title: Titan X Cola Freeze Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Cola Freeze is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This practical refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, providing an easy, flavourful vaping experience without the hassle of manual refilling. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to vape. Cola Freeze captures the classic taste of fizzy Cola with a refreshing menthol twist. Sweet and subtly spiced, with a crisp cooling exhale, this nostalgic flavour is balanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. With a pre-installed mesh coil for optimal flavour delivery and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit pairs perfectly with the Titan X device’s smart auto-refill system, delivering up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
